title: Signed total sections of an augmented pro-etale simplicial object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale site and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on this site and $W$ a site object. For an augmented simplicial object $U_\bullet\to W$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], and a sheaf of $R$-modules $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], restriction of scalars along $R(W)\to R(U_p)$ makes $F(U_p)$ an $R(W)$-module. Restrictions along the simplicial operators give a cosimplicial $R(W)$-module, functorial and additive in $F$. Its alternating coface complex has degree $p\geq0$ term $F(U_p)$, differential $\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j d_j^*$, and zero terms in negative degrees. For a cochain complex $E$ of module sheaves, apply this additive complex functor termwise and exchange the directions so that simplicial degree is first. Define $T_U(E)$ as its coproduct total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]: degree $r$ is $\bigoplus_{p+q=r,\,p\geq0}E^q(U_p)$ and differential is $\delta+(-1)^p d_E$. Coefficient chain maps act componentwise, yielding a functor $T_U$. If $E^q=0$ for $q<N$, only $0\leq p\leq r-N$ contribute in degree $r$, so the effective sum is finite. No hypercover, affineness or contractibility condition is required to define this functor.
